subject: Next steps: throughput & latency deep-dive (dedicated capacity) - scheduling
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Hart <olivia@finreganalytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 8 May 2026 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed next steps: throughput & latency deep-dive

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the productive discovery call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Recap of what you shared
- Primary workload: document summarization + regulatory Q&A for edge cases (avg prompt ~400 tokens, responses ~650 tokens).
- Latency SLO: p95 <= 120ms for short-turn interactive flows; for batch summary jobs longer tail acceptable.
- Peak concurrency: estimate ~90-140 concurrent inference requests in peak (end-of-day batch + interactive).
- Retention/security: data-in-transit + VPC-only access; SOC2/PCI questions to follow via security questionnaire.

Why a dedicated sizing deep-dive
- We want to map model choice + quantization profile + batching strategy to realistic token throughput and p95/p99 latency at your target percentiles.
- Goal: produce a recommended Dedicated capacity config (GPU types, number of instances, autoscale thresholds) and a short mutual action plan.

Proposed next step: scheduling a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive (capacity sizing) with your infra lead + our solutions engineering.
- Agenda (proposed): 1) workload patterns & example traces, 2) target latency/throughput goals, 3) model candidates + quant profiles, 4) preliminary capacity calc & open questions, 5) next steps.

I've attached our capacity-sizing template to collect traces and peak numbers ahead of the call — filling columns highlighted in yellow will make the session much more productive.

Availability (PT):
- Tue 2026-05-12: 10:00–11:30 or 14:00–15:00 PT
- Wed 2026-05-13: 09:00–11:00 PT
- Thu 2026-05-14: 13:00–16:00 PT

Please let me know which slot works (or share a few times that work for Carlos). If helpful I can drop a calendar invite and include Markus (SE) & Monica (Account lead).

Thanks — looking forward to narrowing this down.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
